name: sigmoid-curve
draw: An S shaped logistic curve rising from a low flat line to a high flat line on axes.

name: exponential-curve
draw: A curve on axes that starts flat and rises steeply to the upper right.

name: logarithmic-curve
draw: A curve on axes that rises steeply first and then flattens toward the right.

name: step-function
draw: A staircase of horizontal steps on axes with filled and hollow dots at the jumps.

name: asymptote
draw: A curve approaching a vertical dashed line without touching it.

name: vector-field
draw: A grid of small arrows of varying directions forming a swirling field.

name: complex-plane
draw: Crossed axes labelled Re and Im with an arrow from the origin to a plotted point.

name: light-cone
draw: Two cones meeting tip to tip at an origin point on a vertical time axis.

name: feynman-diagram
draw: Two straight arrows meeting at a vertex joined by a wavy photon line to another vertex with two arrows.

name: long-division
draw: The long division bracket, a curved stroke joined to a top bar, with digits beneath and a quotient above.

name: column-addition
draw: Two stacked numbers with a plus sign on the left and a horizontal line beneath them.

name: factor-tree
draw: A number at the top branching down into pairs of smaller numbers, prime factors circled.

name: ten-frame
draw: A two by five grid of squares with counters filling some of the cells.

name: number-bond
draw: Three circles linked by lines, one whole at the top joined to two parts below.

name: pascals-triangle
draw: Numbers arranged in a triangular stack, rows of 1, 1 1, 1 2 1, 1 3 3 1.

name: magic-square
draw: A three by three grid of numbers where every row and column sums the same.

name: truth-table
draw: A small grid with T and F entries in columns under headings p, q and a result column.

name: roman-numerals
draw: The Roman numerals I V X written in serif capitals.

name: mayan-numerals
draw: Mayan number glyphs: dots above horizontal bars, with a shell shape for zero.

name: eastern-arabic-numerals
draw: Eastern Arabic digits one, two and three written side by side.

name: chinese-numerals
draw: Chinese numerals one, two and three: one, two and three horizontal strokes stacked.

name: cuneiform-numerals
draw: Babylonian cuneiform numerals: rows of small wedge shaped marks pressed as if into clay.

name: hundred-chart
draw: A ten by ten grid of small squares with a few cells highlighted in a pattern.

name: place-value-chart
draw: Three columns headed H, T and O with digit counters in each column.

name: decimal-point
draw: A number with a clearly enlarged dot between digits, such as 3.14.

name: ordinal-number
draw: A number 1 followed by a small raised st, the ordinal first.

name: odd-and-even
draw: Two rows of counters, one row paired up evenly and the other with a single leftover counter.

name: function-machine
draw: A box with an input arrow on the left, an output arrow on the right and f of x printed on the box.

name: turing-machine
draw: A long tape of cells with a read and write head block and a small arrow above one cell.

name: probability-scale
draw: A horizontal scale from 0 to 1 with a marker pointing at one half.

name: reuleaux-triangle
draw: A curved triangle made of three circular arcs, each centered on the opposite corner.

name: interrobang
draw: Interrobang: a question mark and an exclamation mark overlaid into one glyph sharing a single dot.

name: inverted-question-mark
draw: Inverted question mark as used in Spanish: an upside down question mark with the dot on top.

name: inverted-exclamation-mark
draw: Inverted exclamation mark as used in Spanish: a dot on top and a tapering bar below.

name: double-exclamation-mark
draw: Two exclamation marks side by side, each a tapering bar above a dot.

name: exclamation-question-mark
draw: An exclamation mark followed by a question mark side by side.

name: semicolon
draw: A semicolon: a round dot above a comma with a short curved tail.

name: colon-punctuation
draw: A colon: two round dots stacked vertically.

name: comma-punctuation
draw: A single large comma: a round dot with a curved tail sweeping down and left.

name: guillemets
draw: Double angle quotation marks: two pairs of small chevrons pointing outward on either side of a short line of text.

name: lenticular-brackets
draw: Solid lenticular brackets: two thick bracket shapes with curved inner sides facing each other.

name: dagger
draw: Dagger mark: a vertical stroke with a short crossbar near the top, like a slim cross.

name: double-dagger
draw: Double dagger mark: a vertical stroke with two short crossbars, one near the top and one near the bottom.

name: asterism-mark
draw: Asterism: three small asterisks arranged in a triangle, two below and one above.

name: hedera
draw: Hedera ivy leaf dingbat: a heart shaped leaf with a curling stem.

name: numero-sign
draw: Numero sign: a capital N followed by a small raised o with a bar under it.

name: care-of-sign
draw: Care of sign: a small c above a diagonal slash above a small o.

name: sound-recording-copyright
draw: Sound recording copyright symbol: a capital P inside a circle.

name: service-mark
draw: Service mark: a small raised SM in superscript beside a short line of text.

name: copyleft
draw: Copyleft symbol: a reversed capital C inside a circle, opening to the left.

name: ditto-mark
draw: Ditto mark: two short slanted strokes placed under a word in a list.

name: tilde
draw: A single large tilde: a smooth horizontal wave with one rise and one dip.

name: backslash
draw: A backslash: a single stroke leaning from top left to bottom right.

name: vertical-bar
draw: A vertical bar or pipe: one tall straight stroke with a small gap to show it is a glyph.

name: tironian-et
draw: Tironian et: a shape like a 7 with a short foot, the old Latin sign for and.

name: prime-marks
draw: Prime and double prime marks: one and two slanted ticks after a number, for feet and inches.

name: estimated-sign
draw: Estimated sign: a slim lowercase e with a crossbar, used on packaging to mark average contents.

name: acute-accent
draw: The letter e with a short slanted acute accent stroke above it.

name: circumflex-accent
draw: The letter e with a small caret shaped circumflex above it.

name: diaeresis
draw: The letter e with two dots side by side above it.

name: cedilla
draw: The letter c with a small hooked cedilla tail below it.

name: macron
draw: The letter a with a short flat bar above it.

name: breve
draw: The letter a with a small cup shaped breve above it.

name: ring-above
draw: The letter a with a small circle sitting above it.

name: tilde-accent
draw: The letter n with a small wavy tilde above it.

name: ogonek
draw: The letter e with a small hooked tail curling to the right at its base.

name: double-acute-accent
draw: The letter o with two short slanted strokes above it.

name: schwa
draw: Schwa: an upside down lowercase e, the neutral vowel of phonetics.

name: eszett
draw: Eszett sharp s: a tall German letter like a B with an open lower bowl and a long left stem.

name: thorn-letter
draw: Thorn letter: a tall vertical stem with a small bowl attached midway on the right.

name: eth-letter
draw: Eth letter: a round bowl with a curved ascender crossed by a short bar.

name: ae-ligature
draw: Ae ligature: a lowercase a and e joined into one glyph sharing a stroke.

name: oe-ligature
draw: Oe ligature: a lowercase o and e joined into one glyph sharing a stroke.

name: fi-ligature
draw: Fi ligature: an f whose hooked top joins the dot of the i in one connected glyph.

name: ipa-glottal-stop
draw: Glottal stop symbol: a question mark shape without the dot, sitting on the baseline.

name: ipa-eng
draw: Eng letter: a lowercase n whose right leg continues down below the baseline into a hook.

name: serif-font
draw: A capital A in a serif typeface with clear bracketed serifs at its feet.

name: sans-serif-font
draw: A capital A in a plain sans serif typeface with flat stroke ends.

name: monospace-font
draw: Three letters in a fixed width typeface, each sitting in its own equal width cell.

name: script-font
draw: A flowing handwritten capital letter with a looped swash tail.
